rejection_summary.title: The Trap (Die Falle)
rejection_summary.reason: Netflix's six-episode German psychological thriller releases on October 13, 2026. The trailer, premise and episode descriptions indicate a potentially relevant murderer-identification and cat-and-mouse story, but at this research time there is not enough independent whole-season review or episode-resolution evidence to establish revelation_frequency, progressive_revelation and the complete 30-dimension DNA without guessing. Reconsider when credible full-season coverage exists. Sources consulted: https://about.netflix.com/en/news/the-trap-no-one-escapes-their-past-netflix-releases-the-official-trailer-and-press-kit-for-the-new-psychological-thriller-series-highlight and https://www.netflix.com/title/81720671.
